This listing is a physical poster print, for entertainment purposes only. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Leo posters nearly all pair 'LEO' with a lion illustration; this poster shows the glyph, so 'leo lion' phrases were left out.
Dates vary between July 22 and July 23 starts; physical prints run about $7-50 in snippets.
Most single-sign Etsy results are digital downloads; stating 'physical poster print' separates this listing.
Minimalist glyph-only sign prints exist but are mostly A4/A5 printables; the common styles are constellations, gradient 'aura' circles, and illustrations.
Leo prints on Amazon are 11x14 unframed constellation and vintage lion designs, up to 24x36 licensed art.
Amazon zodiac titles spell out size plus 'unframed' and the room (bedroom, living room, office); 12-sign sets, canvases, and tin signs crowd the results.

research.notes: Listing pages were not reachable from this environment; evidence is from search results only. 'leo zodiac poster' is the sign-plus-product phrase in competitor titles and the query run; sign tags use the glyph, dates, and traits printed on this poster. Birth-month phrasing follows competitors' month-based birthday titles. No priceRange: snippets did not separate physical, unframed prints from framed prints and digital downloads.
